integration_layers.name: AI Ingestion & Capability Layer
integration_layers.note: Runtime integration architecture (manifest, corpus, capability, runtime control, governance surfaces). Not a seventh rights protocol -- it orchestrates evaluation of the AIRS/AICR/AICL-C, AARS, and AADP decision planes around capability invocation.

ethical_layers.name: Minimum Ethical Protection
ethical_layers.note: Cross-layer ethical proposition (not a machine-enforceable protocol). v0.1.1 adds the Proportional Inspection Principle, operationalized through AADP's inspection_required/inspection_ceiling fields.

protocols.name: AI Content Rights / AI Content Rules
protocols.summary: Machine-readable declaration of what AI systems may do with content: read, summarize, quote, RAG, transform, train, commercial use, redistribute.

protocols.name: AI Content License / AI Content Licensing Layer
protocols.summary: Licensing and transaction layer on top of AICR: license tiers, quote/pay/verify/revoke endpoints, license tokens, audit logs, HTTP 402 interoperability.

protocols.name: AI Rights Spectrum
protocols.summary: AI rights over content as a graduated spectrum of eight levels, each independently licensable and auditable.

protocols.name: AI Learning Permission Protocol
protocols.summary: Dimension-level learning permissions: access, indexing, inference input, embedding, training, fine-tuning, distillation, memory, attribution, compensation.

protocols.name: Agent Action Rights Spectrum
protocols.summary: What an AI agent may DO once it holds tool or API capability -- an A0-A7 action spectrum plus a machine-readable action vector (read/write/execute/external/transaction/delegation/persistence), independent of content permission.

protocols.name: Agent Authority & Delegation Protocol
protocols.summary: Who authorized an agent's action and how far that authority reaches -- principal vs. actor, delegation that can only narrow, and a bounded inspection ceiling (I0-I7).

related_tracks.name: Agentic Payment
related_tracks.summary: Bounded agent payments for licensed content: human-approved budgets, request-bound tokens, audit trails; AI never handles raw card data.
